ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure 1-1 is a certain river's discharge process line, with the horizontal axis being January to December and the vertical axis being discharge Q. The curve shows that this river's discharge is very low from June to August, close to the annual low point; while from January to April and from September to November, the discharge is relatively high. Then reason: the stem states that this river is mainly supplied by precipitation, so the decrease in river discharge mainly reflects a decrease in local precipitation. The low discharge from June to August indicates that this region at this time has little rain in summer and a dry climate, fitting the characteristic of "winter rain and summer dryness." The main pressure belt causing summer drought is the subtropical high-pressure belt; its descending air currents make precipitation little, so the decrease in this river's discharge from June to August is because it is controlled by the subtropical high-pressure belt.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的河流量曲线：6—8月流量处于全年低值，冬半年和秋季流量较高。再结合题干“以降水补给为主”，把流量低谷解释为当地6—8月降水少。由冬雨夏干的水文特征判断该地属于夏季干旱型气候，关键气压带为副热带高气压带，因此回答受副热带高气压带控制。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图1-1是某河流量过程线，横轴为1—12月，纵轴为流量Q。曲线显示该河在6—8月流量很低，接近全年低谷；而1—4月以及9—11月流量相对较高。再推理：题干说明该河以降水补给为主，因此河流量减少主要反映当地降水减少。6—8月流量低，说明该地区此时夏季少雨、气候干旱，符合“冬雨夏干”的特征。造成夏季干旱的主要气压带是副热带高气压带，其下沉气流使降水少，所以该河6—8月流量减少是因为受副热带高气压带控制。
